versions.content: Provide diagnostic state information to applications Description: Applications need to know about the actual session and security state, because it is not predictable if the information’s lead to a different functional diagnostic behavior. Rationale: Functional requirement Use Case: With the diagnostic session which the garage is using, it is allowed to switch between different sets of parameters. With an enhanced diagnostic session which could be used in development and a corresponding security level, it is allowed to change the data within the set of parameters. AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
